slug: 2024-09-13 ZILAS - Your Gateway to Modern Land Administration (SMART Zambia)

facts.fact: SMART Zambia Institute says the Zambia Integrated Land Administration System (ZILAS) is deployed and 100% digital, handling land administration in Zambia.
SMART Zambia Institute says users can apply for any land-related matter through ZILAS web and mobile interfaces, accessed via the Government Service Bus.

slug: 2024-09-13 Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources Goes Digital (SMART Zambia)

facts.fact: A Ministry of Lands ICT officer says ZILAS, deployed by the SMART Zambia Institute and hosted on the Government Service Bus, is in use and issuance of title deeds is now digitally processed.

systems.owner: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development

note: A mining licence cadastre, not a register of land rights and parcels.

facts.fact: ZILAS, run by the Ministry of Lands, is described as in service and generating digital title deeds with unique validation stamps.
Law Association of Zambia president says users can submit and track land documents online and pay by electronic banking channels, without travelling to Lusaka or regional offices.

note: Document states nothing on land records.

facts.fact: Zambian Business Times, citing an official report (the Auditor General's 2025 report), says the legacy ZILMIS land system was replaced by ZILAS, with 982 property records missing after migration.
